records.subject: spec-guard-a10-native-only-same-mac
evidence: result:the installed host exposed exactly the ten reviewed bridge mailbox tools and no worker, orchestration, or lifecycle tools
result:one exact Claude session completed two Claude-to-Codex result routes across an idle continuation; Codex then completed one direct Codex-to-Claude request and same-thread reply
result:every processed delivery was acknowledged by its receiver and visible as acknowledged to its sender; the reverse wake record reached read
cleanup:the exact synthetic session was cancelled, both identities were retired at unread zero, history was retained, and acceptance tasks were archived
result:the public repository had three open Proposal issues and no open issue labelled P1 or P2 at the observation time

records.subject: spec-guard-a10-compatibility-rollback
records.reason: v0.40.0 is native-only by the accepted 2026-10-04 sunset decision. The compatibility runtime and fallback are intentionally absent, so rollback is not a current product acceptance path.

records.subject: spec-guard-a10-cross-machine
records.reason: The supported collaboration scope is one Mac. No cross-machine discovery, connection, or wake guarantee is claimed.
